svg.title: Debrief: a two-minute tour
svg.desc: 1. Open the samples: Pick a folder or drop it on the window; formats are detected from the content. 2. Load the sample profile: Extractors turn text lines into fields such as CPU and memory. 3. Read the timeline: One lane per process; drag across it to zoom to the minutes that matter. 4. Inspect an event: Click an event to see every property, with its source file and line.
